stem: What was one way that Betty Friedan influenced the women’s movement of the 1960s and 1970s?

options.label: A
options.text: She worked as a member of Congress to pass laws on women’s health issues.

options.label: B
options.text: She encouraged women to support the election of conservative political leaders.

options.label: C
options.text: She wrote a book challenging people to question the traditional roles of women.

options.label: D
options.text: She encouraged women to oppose the Equal Rights Amendment.
